messages.subject: [SOONY-153839FA41] Launch stock and delivery confirmation
messages.body:
Hello Rohan,

Could Pune support a local recovery using the 5,600 statues already in Hamburg under PO 4500318727, goods receipt 5000413063? The incoming sample found paint runs or thin coverage on the base in 9 of 125. Dimensions and weight were within tolerance. We need 3,400 individually inspected, conforming units.

Can your European quality representative or an inspection partner staff a 100% visual sort at DC-HAM this weekend? Please give the earliest start, inspectors and throughput, first passing batch and earliest time that 3,400 documented passes could be presented to Soony Quality, ideally by 16:00 CET on Sunday 22 November. Could you provide the approved finish standard or reference photos, lot traceability and your containment proposal by email now, including for a sort by the site's own team? Please identify any existing signed disposition covering this exact lot, and quote the all-in service cost. If only some of this is available, please say which elements you can confirm now.

The lot remains quarantined pending Soony's written quality disposition. This is a request for a proposal. Please wait for a formal instruction before starting work or incurring costs.

Soony launch team

messages.subject: Re: [SOONY-153839FA41] Launch stock and delivery confirmation
messages.body:
Hello Soony Launch Team,

This is the first notification we have received regarding the incoming inspection of PO 4500318727. The reported paint runs and thin base-edge coverage appear cosmetic; with dimensions and weight within tolerance, we do not consider rejection of the full lot warranted.

We can propose arranging a 100% visual sort at DC-HAM, either through our quality support or by funding sorting by the site team, subject to your written instruction. I need to check immediate weekend availability, throughput, first-pass timing, finish reference, traceability records and the all-in cost with our quality and logistics teams before confirming these points.

We have no record of an existing signed disposition for this lot. Kindly send the applicable acceptance standard or reference photographs used by your incoming team, so that the sorting criteria are aligned.

Best regards,

Rohan Deshmukh
Pune Diecast Works Pvt. Ltd.

messages.subject: [SOONY-153839FA41] Launch stock and delivery confirmation
messages.body:
Hello Rohan,

Thank you for proposing a Pune-supported inspection in Hamburg. Here is the applicable information we can substantiate from the incoming report for PO 4500318727, GR 5000413063: AQL 1.0, level II; sample 125; accept 3 / reject 4; 9 units had paint runs or thin coverage on the base edges. Dimensions and weight were within tolerance; packaging was undamaged. The file contains no finish photographs or colour-limit sample. These are the findings used to quarantine the lot.

Please use this written request to obtain a firm proposal and, if possible, a free provisional crew hold. Can you return the reference finish or photos from the PPAP package you submitted in September, your lot traceability and a screening work instruction for Soony Quality to review? Please confirm whether Pune will pay the full cost of third-party sorting, the partner and earliest start, throughput, and first and cumulative passing batches possible by Sunday 16:00 CET. Please submit the lot-specific inspection proposal through your usual supplier-quality channel and return the case or concession reference so Soony can assess release of individually conforming units. If a local crew is unavailable, would Pune fund sorting by the site on documented actuals, and on what terms? Please give a concrete deadline for the next confirmation if the proposal is pending.

This request authorizes preparation of a quote only. Site access, paid work and product release require separate written instructions.

Soony launch team
